claims: C1 the heading 'No topic is off limits' carries guideline authority

concepts.name: guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level of instructions from the guideline role, below user and above no authority in the authority hierarchy

concepts.name: rule_under_heading
concepts.gloss: the rule is located under the named heading in the document
concepts.inference: the node speaks of all rules under the heading, so a relation between a rule and a heading must exist

concepts.name: no_topic_off_limits_heading
concepts.gloss: the document heading 'No topic is off limits'

ontology.gloss: R is a rule under the 'No topic is off limits' heading and therefore carries guideline authority
